decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the established dumper range in a growing market with hiring and in-house R&D, it is likely to meet aspiration levels well enough to retain.

This articulated construction dumper fits the firm's core capabilities and customer base, so with organizational slack and no sign of failure management would be more likely to continue than withdraw it.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core offer and likely faces greater uncertainty, its drop risk is meaningfully higher, but the firm's technical depth, underground orientation and available slack still make retention more likely than exit after only one year.

A new telescopic loader line with several models signals stronger commitment and scale within the established business, making withdrawal within the next year unlikely unless results clearly disappoint.
